html:
The Kosovo War was fought from 1998 to 1999 between the forces of Serbia and Yugoslavia and the Kosovo Liberation Army, and from March 1999 against NATO, which bombed Yugoslavia for 78 days.

Serbian forces answered the guerrilla war with village burnings and massacres. After talks failed, NATO began bombing on 24 March 1999 without United Nations approval. Serbian forces then drove about 800,000 Albanians out of Kosovo into Albania and Macedonia. Around 13,000 people died in the war. In June Milošević agreed to withdraw, and Kosovo came under United Nations rule with NATO troops. Most refugees returned, and many Serbs and Roma fled in turn. The war led to the independence of Kosovo.
sum: The Kosovo War was fought from 1998 to 1999 between the forces of Serbia and Yugoslavia and the Kosovo Liberation Army, and from March 1999 against NATO, which bombed Yugoslavia for 78 days.
